invite.web.documentTitle.evidence: https://partiful.com/e/egrwj3biCR6g5MLJ0dbv page HTML (design/research/wrapped-tribute-partiful.md §5.4): <title>/og:title 'Tompkins Square Dog Parade | Partiful'; references/auto/partiful/web/pf-web-notfound-01.png + pf-web-notfound.computed-styles.json (https://partiful.com/e/AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA): <title> 'Not Found | Partiful'
invite.web.documentTitle.pattern: P-IW-T document title '{Event title} | Partiful' (examples 'Tompkins Square Dog Parade | Partiful', 'Not Found | Partiful'); the brand is replaced by {app_name}
invite.web.documentTitle.notes: {title} = the group name (valid invite) or the state's short title. Used for <title>, og:title and twitter:title. BLOCKED while the app has no name.

invite.web.cover.alt.evidence: https://partiful.com/e/egrwj3biCR6g5MLJ0dbv page HTML (design/research/wrapped-tribute-partiful.md §5.4): og:image:alt 'Tompkins Square Dog Parade Event Cover Image'
invite.web.cover.alt.pattern: P-IW-A image alt '{Event title} Event Cover Image'; noun swap Event → Group

invite.web.invitedBy.evidence: references/auto/partiful/web/pf-web-public-light-02.png and pf-web-public-light.computed-styles.json ('Hosted by New York Dog Parade', one 16/400 row)
invite.web.invitedBy.pattern: P-IW-4 event-field row '{Participle} by {name}' (example 'Hosted by New York Dog Parade'); the inviter is not a host, so 'Hosted' becomes 'Invited'
invite.web.invitedBy.notes: {first_name} = invite_preview.inviter_first_name. The row is left out when it is null.

invite.web.members.title.pattern: P-IW-5 section label in Title Case; noun swap Guest → Member ('Guest List')
invite.web.members.title.notes: The reference's count line ('11 Went · 4 Maybe') and '+N' disc are do-not-copy (tenet 2).

invite.web.gate.body.text: Verify your phone number to view the group's photos
invite.web.gate.body.evidence: references/auto/partiful/web/pf-web-private-past-02.png (https://partiful.com/e/6p1Hm5OlE2YIH1VX515z) ('Verify your phone number to view event details and activity')
invite.web.gate.body.pattern: P-IW-1 gate explanation 'Verify your phone number to view {things}'; noun phrase swap 'event details and activity' → 'the group's photos'
invite.web.gate.body.notes: No final period, as in the reference. Members are not named in the swap because first names and avatars are already shown.

invite.web.getApp.notes: Members-only card button and footer link (both open the store / App Clip).

invite.web.state.glyph.notes: Emoji glyph of every non-ideal state (U+1F62C).

invite.web.notFound.title.evidence: references/auto/partiful/js/partiful-web-js-excerpt-2026-10-15.js [C] tO.default({message:e3('Event not found')}) — the event page's not-found message passed to the 404 component
invite.web.notFound.title.pattern: P-IW-6 not-found message '{Noun} not found' (examples 'Event not found', 'Page Not Found'); noun swap Event → Invite

invite.web.unavailable.title.evidence: references/auto/partiful/js/partiful-web-js-excerpt-2026-10-15.js [D] 'The existing link will no longer work.'; [H] 'This link won't work once disabled.'
invite.web.unavailable.title.pattern: P-IW-7 link status statement (examples 'The existing link will no longer work.', 'This link won't work once disabled.'); present tense because the link has already expired or been revoked; no period, as a state title
invite.web.unavailable.title.notes: Expired and revoked invites share this state, so the page does not reveal which.

invite.web.unavailable.body.text: Ask a member for another link
invite.web.unavailable.body.evidence: references/auto/partiful/js/partiful-web-js-excerpt-2026-10-15.js [C] 'Could not add as check-in staff. Try again, or ask the host for another link'
invite.web.unavailable.body.pattern: P-IW-8 recovery hint '…ask the host for another link' (Partiful); noun swap host → member; 'Try again, or' dropped because retrying an expired or revoked link cannot succeed

invite.web.error.title.evidence: references/auto/partiful/js/partiful-web-js-excerpt-2026-10-15.js [C] 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'; [E] title 'Something went wrong \uD83D\uDE2C'
invite.web.error.title.notes: The emoji is the state glyph above.

invite.web.rateLimited.body.text: You've tried too many times - please try again later
invite.web.rateLimited.body.notes: Body of the error state when the per-address limit is reached (HTTP 429).

invite.appclip.card.action.notes: One of Apple's preset App Clip actions; chosen in App Store Connect (default and advanced experience), not in code.

invite.appclip.card.subtitle.notes: Entered in App Store Connect (≤56 characters, Apple HIG). docs/OWNER_SETUP.md §1.5 lets the owner replace it.

invite.appclip.sheet.helper.text: Just for group updates. No spam.
invite.appclip.sheet.helper.pattern: P-IW-2 reassurance 'Just for {purpose}. No spam.'; noun swap event → group

invite.appclip.join.evidence: references/auto/partiful/js/partiful-web-js-excerpt-2026-10-15.js [J] RSVP button label for the waitlist status: label:(0,a.ab)('Join')
invite.appclip.join.notes: The members-only card's action inside the App Clip (the web page's 'Get the app' would point at the store the clip replaces). Opens the join sheet.

invite.appclip.full.glyphLabel.evidence: references/auto/partiful/js/partiful-web-js-excerpt-2026-10-15.js [B] (the not-found glyph is labelled with its Unicode name, 'Grimace face')
invite.appclip.full.glyphLabel.pattern: P-IW-A2 glyph label: the emoji's face named in sentence case (Partiful: 'Grimace face' for U+1F62C); the name used is the Unicode CLDR short name of U+1F62D, 'loudly crying face'

invite.appclip.full.title.pattern: partiful.voice.labels; adaptation rule RSVP → join (design/copy-patterns.md 'Adaptation rules')
invite.appclip.full.title.notes: join_group fails with group_full (30 members, docs/API.md §6.1).

invite.appclip.offline.body.text: This usually occurs due to a poor internet connection - try again in a few minutes
invite.appclip.offline.body.notes: Offline / network failure in the App Clip (title invite.web.error.title, glyph invite.web.state.glyph, action invite.web.error.retry).
